rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user, then retrieved orders and specific order details. It confirmed the order was pending, gathered the requested changes (backpack variant and shipping address), summarized the exact changes, and sought explicit confirmation before performing any writes. It checked product variants and correctly selected the grey/medium/polyester/laptop backpack. After confirmation, it modified the item via the tool; the shipping address was already the default Charlotte address, so no separate address change was needed, and the agent accurately reported that the address remains the default. The price difference was correctly charged to the gift card, consistent with the tool’s payment history, and the agent provided correct final information when asked about payment method. No actions were taken without proper authentication or confirmation, and no unsupported statements were made. Minor note: the agent did not explicitly warn about the extra charge before proceeding, but it did obtain confirmation to apply the requested updates. Overall, this meets the pass bar.
